intervals.quote: MAGIC became recently a stereoscopic Cherenkov observatory with the inauguration of its second telescope, MAGIC-II

summary.plain: Two 17-metre dish telescopes on a Spanish island mountaintop, working together to catch the flicker of blue light made by gamma rays hitting the atmosphere.
summary.technical: Two 17 m imaging atmospheric Cherenkov telescopes at Roque de los Muchachos, La Palma; MAGIC-I active since October 2003, stereoscopic operation with MAGIC-II since around 2009, camera/readout upgrade in 2011-2012.

technology.quote: MAGIC is a system of two Imaging Atmospheric Cherenkov Telescopes located in the Canary island of La Palma, Spain
technology.value: Two 17 m imaging atmospheric Cherenkov telescopes operated stereoscopically.
